gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
We had to call ___ the order because the kitchen had closed.
It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
They've just moved ___ to their new flat.
gaps.explanation: move in = start living in a new home.

gaps.sentence: The car broke ___ on the motorway.
Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: It's time you faced up ___ your responsibilities.
gaps.explanation: face up TO something = accept and deal with something difficult.
